title: Teaching and Critiquing Conceptualization and Operationalization in NLP
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on pedagogical methods for teaching critical thinking about concepts such as bias, stereotypes, race, and gender in NLP research, with no mention of religious concepts.

measurement_description: The paper does not present a benchmark and does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It describes a seminar course designed to teach students how to critique conceptualization and operationalization of abstract concepts in NLP.
